policy_notes: The 10,000-example readiness floor is the operator-directed first proper foundation curriculum, not a scientific claim about convergence.
The deterministic foundation corpus is intentionally one broad curriculum; semantic concept breadth is measured during later concept-learning stages rather than by its single top-level label.

The retained foundation plateau is 8,504 examples: three direct 500-example continuations from checkpoint 0008 at learning rates 2e-4, 5e-5, and 1e-5 all regressed protected and overall behavior, so the original 10,000-example planning floor must not override checkpoint quality.
A structurally healthy foundational checkpoint may continue the lineage without being behaviorally admitted.
Only an admitted certificate creates a campaign winner.
